# skills-graph

`<SkillsGraph>`: the author's skills as a program graph (AGENTS.md as `main()`,
arrows as real cross-references, the meta skills in `--hl`), one run of
execution travelling down it while on screen, each skill's file and purpose on
hover. Ported verbatim from the prototype's `skills-graph.js`
(`proto-1794207359-w7ez6h`): `internal/skills-graph.ts` draws into the host's
shadow root and owns it; the component re-lays it out on a width change.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The story's skills graph: <SkillsGraph> draws the author's skills as a program — AGENTS.md as main(), the everyday skills (complete a task, answer a question, fix a bug, write tests first) funnelling into the meta skills (self-improvement, meta-fix, think a level higher, update skill, write a skill) in the highlight colour — with one run of execution travelling down it while on screen, and each skill's file and purpose on hover.
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `apps/website/shell.websitePagePart`
    - `primitives/dom/element-size.useResizeObserver`
    - `primitives/dom/in-view.createInViewWatcher`
  - Exports (values): `SkillsGraph`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `apps/website/pages/story/essay`
